_comment: Upstream code pins for the 400-run benchmark (results/unified_results_4engines_100obj.csv).
purpose: Pin the repos the kernels clone unpinned, so a future HEAD move cannot silently change what produced the published numbers. Two pin classes: (a) nine repos pinned at their HEAD as of 2026-11-22 — for each of these, HEAD today equals HEAD at run time because the HEAD commit predates the publish run (2026-10-26) and has not moved since, so pinning is a no-op for the published data; (b) microsoft/TRELLIS, pinned at 442aa1e1af — the tip of main for the entire publish run, and deliberately NOT today's HEAD, because main advanced on 2026-10-27 (193e0502b5, CI-only). Both classes are no-ops for the published data; class (b) is a robustness pin only.

benchmark_code.note: Published baseline. Already pinned by every kernel's shallow fetch.

triposr_repo_sha.state_at_publish: unpinned clone; HEAD resolved to this SHA and has not moved since 2026-06-04
triposr_repo_sha.robustness: pure no-op - commit predates the publish run

lgm_repo_sha.state_at_publish: unpinned clone; dormant repo, same SHA since 2024-04-03

rasterizer_sha.note: Compiled as a CUDA extension. A HEAD move here would change rasterization numerics for all LGM metrics.

clip_repo_sha.state_at_publish: unpinned clone; HEAD predates the run

do_not_upgrade_to.why: Two later commits touch ONLY .github/dependabot.yml and .github/workflows/codeql.yml: 2b22e06784098195c0490d019c88f59119467fdc (authored 2026-08-24, 'Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit SHAs') and 193e0502b5cb3eb5997ec457d5340e95d09b158e (2026-10-27 05:00 UTC, PR #364, same purpose). Neither touches library code, so neither changes FlexiCubes or any metric — the 'CI-only, harmless' conclusion stands. Reachability, however, is NOT implied by commit dates: 2b22e06784 was NOT in the published run's history. It sat on a side branch whose parent is 442aa1e1af and entered main only via the 2026-10-27 merge 193e0502b5, whose parents are [442aa1e1af, 2b22e06784]. On 2026-10-26 main's tip was 442aa1e1af — what an unpinned clone would have fetched, and what the in-kernel checkout -f pins; both paths agree, which is what makes the published TRELLIS code bit-identical.

utils3d.note: Pinned inline in the pip install line of batch2/verify kernels. Not in cloned_repos because it is a pip dependency, not a clone.

weight_provenance._comment: Why the pins below can stand in for the publish-run snapshots.
weight_provenance.at_publish_commit: git grep revision= -- src/engines/ returns NOTHING at 09131e61 — no HF revision was pinned when the 400 rows were produced.
weight_provenance.pins_added: 2026-11-15, by SEC-11 (04548dd, fix(sec-11)) and SEC-07 (18b222d, fix(sec-07)). 04548dd is exactly 10 insertions / 2 deletions across the four engine files, pure revision= kwargs, zero logic changes.
weight_provenance.snapshot_equivalence: Every HF repo HEAD today equals its pinned revision, and every lastModified predates 2026-10-26; therefore the November pins are byte-identical to the October publish-run snapshots.
weight_provenance.pinned_paper_code_commit: aae25900d34298a5188d9d85ee6394aaa769928c (branch pinned/v35-paper, tag v35-pinned) = 09131e61 + 04548dd cherry-picked. Single commit carrying both the code that produced the 400 rows and the weight pins that secure them.
known_accepted_risks: ImageDream (ashawkey/imagedream-ipmv-diffusers) remains unpinned at 09131e61; only a 7-char 73a0341 pin exists downstream. Harmless: the repo has not changed since 2024-01-14.

trust_remote_code=True is present at 09131e61 for ImageDream's mv_unet.py — a known accepted risk inherited from the publish run (SEC-07's snapshot_download rewrite is a behaviour change, deliberately excluded from aae2590).

hf_model_pins._comment: Already enforced in src/engines/*.py via revision=. Listed for a single source of truth.

imagedream_weights.note: SHORT (7-char) pin - the only non-40-char pin in the codebase. Worth upgrading to the full SHA.

spar3d_weights.note: Access granted 2026-11-22. Which checkpoint the published run used is indeterminate: at 09131e6 the fallback to the mirror was UNCONDITIONAL on any primary-repo failure, and nothing records which branch was taken. Immaterial: both checkpoints are 7,326,949,440 bytes with identical config.yaml.

spar3d_mirror_weights.note: Community mirror, byte-identical checkpoint to the official repo (7,326,949,440 bytes, identical config.yaml). Whether the published run used the mirror or the primary is indeterminate — see spar3d_weights.

non_hf_runtime_assets._comment: SHA-256 pinned and verified in src/model_weights.py before use.
